name: Ramesh Balwani
bio: Ramesh "Sunny" Balwani (born June 13, 1965) is a businessman who was the former president and chief operating officer of Theranos, which was a privately held health technology company founded by his then-girlfriend Elizabeth Holmes. He and Holmes fraudulently represented that they had devised a revolutionary blood test that required only small amounts of blood, such as from a fingerstick. Starting in 2015, Theranos came under criticism in the media due to its questionable claims and practices. The consequences of the fraud led to the collapse of Theranos, while private investors lost $700M to $945M in real money. The company was eventually liquidated.

credits.title: You Can See Everything
credits.overview: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

credits.title: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
credits.overview: With a magical new invention that promised to revolutionize blood testing, Elizabeth Holmes became the world’s youngest self-made billionaire, heralded as the next Steve Jobs. Then, overnight, her 10-billion-dollar company dissolved. The rise and fall of Theranos is a window into the psychology of fraud.
